name: zhida-codex
description: Connect Codex to Zhida conversations, retrieval logs, knowledge bases, and keyword changes.

interface.shortDescription: Optimize Zhida knowledge bases from real support traces.
interface.longDescription: Zhida Codex connects Codex to the authorized Zhida project through OAuth and a hosted MCP server. It can inspect conversations, retrieval traces, knowledge base entries, keywords, and apply reviewed changesets.
defaultPrompt: Analyze recent Zhida replies and propose knowledge changes.
Inspect this request_id and explain the retrieval trace.
Preview a knowledge-base changeset for these fixes.
